Our Customer Success team is committed to helping customers maximize the value of Asana as both a technology platform and a holistic approach to collaboration. From high touch to scalable success, our goal is to deepen the usage of the whole work graph, resulting in delivering unmatched value with scalability and consistency. We strive to help all of our customers, across countries, industries, and functions, get off on the right foot and continue to get the most value out of Asana over time.
As a Digital & Scaled CS Program Manager, you will be a hands-on, technically adept owner of the build and execution layer of our Digital and Scaled CS program. Sitting at the intersection of Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Product Engineering, you will be the driving force behind turning digital CS strategy into working programs, maintained playbooks, enabled teams, and well-run vendor partnerships. Day to day, you will design and refine customer journeys, manage vendor relationships, and ensure every active program reflects both lifecycle best practices and real-world account reality.
This role is based in our Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requireme nts.
What you’ll achieve
Digital Program Execution: Design, build, and refine campaigns and journey orchestrations in tools like Iterable, Outreach, Pocus, and Trig. Define lifecycle stages, trigger logic, and intervention sequencing while building and validating audiences in the CDP to ensure sound data quality before launch.
Program Governance & Quality: Maintain program governance through weekly checks, reviewing active journeys, flagging anomalies, and ensuring live programs reflect current business strategy.
Vendor Partnership Management: Own the day-to-day management of vendor partnerships, running standing cadences, tracking performance against KPIs, and handling escalations to align delivery with Scaled CS goals.
Playbooks & Enablement: Maintain and update playbooks to reflect changes in the Scaled motion. Build and review enablement materials to equip the Customer Success team to execute programs effectively and consistently.
Scaled Content Delivery: Plan and execute webinars and scaled content assets that deepen adoption and drive customer engagement, coordinating across Marketing and CS to align with overall strategy.
Commercial & Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate across Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Revenue Analytics, Marketing, Enterprise Technology, and Product Engineering to ensure programs reflect ground-level account reality and resolve data questions proactively.
About you
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
4+ years of experience in Customer Success, CS Operations, or Marketing Automation, with at least 2 years building digital programs in a B2B SaaS environment.
Proven ability to design, build, and run customer journey orchestrations in tools such as Iterable, Outreach, Gainsight, or similar, including lifecycle stage definition, trigger logic, and audience management.
Strong program build discipline with experience maintaining playbooks, managing governance processes, and ensuring quality before programs go live.
Commercial awareness with the ability to hold credible conversations with Sales regarding pipeline, account risk, and deal stages.
Proactive problem-solver with strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work independently on data questions without unnecessary escalation.
Clear, organized communicator who builds alignment across stakeholders and obtains appropriate sign-off before implementing program changes.

Asana is hiring a Head of IT Systems Engineering to lead the team that powers how every Asana employee works. Reporting to the Head of IT, this San Francisco-based leader owns the strategy, architecture, and operations behind our SaaS productivity applications, corporate endpoints, identity, and user lifecycle, setting the standards and roadmap that keep every employee secure and productive. You will also influence the way Asana evaluates, adopts, and governs the tools and platforms our employees rely on. You will be responsible for the Client Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Identity & Integrations teams, who deliver this work. This role has one manager level report.
You ask good questions, are confident in not knowing everything, and would rather build with others than go it alone. You are crisp and detail oriented, but comfortable working outside the boundaries when the situation calls for it. You bring a proven record of success, a passion for technology, and, like us, you value hard work and fun in equal measure.
This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
What you’ll achieve
Develop the multi-year vision, roadmap, and architecture for Systems Engineering, aligned with Asana’s business priorities and Asana’s broader AI strategy
Accelerate an Agentified Asana, helping teams across Asana embrace our tools and reduce the friction of manual work.
Partner with leaders across Asana to build and maintain an efficient and effective portfolio of SaaS tools to enable all Asanas to do their best work.
Lead, develop, and grow the Client Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Identity & Integrations teams, including hiring, performance management, succession planning, and career development
Own the strategy and operation of corporate endpoint management, SaaS application management, identity, and the full user lifecycle
Drive IT’s AI strategy, from evaluating and governing platforms such as Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI to building AI agents and automation for onboarding, access requests, support, and compliance workflows
Partner with Security, Legal, and Privacy to set AI usage policies, data access controls, and vendor risk standards, including identity-based access and data loss prevention for AI tools and integrations
Set client platform standards and drive excellence in system performance, patching, and configuration compliance
Partner with IT Support, IT Infrastructure, and Security leadership to resolve issues, reduce risk, and improve the employee experience
Represent Systems Engineering to senior stakeholders, communicating priorities, tradeoffs, and results clearly
About you
10+ years of IT experience, including 5+ years directly leading teams of systems engineers and software engineers in a fast-paced, cloud-first environment
Proven ownership of purchasing, inventory management, and budgeting at scale
Strong, hands-on knowledge of current IAM practices and cloud-based identity, SSO, SAML, and SCIM
Experience with hosted cloud applications, including Okta, Google Workspace, Asana, Figma, and Slack
Experience establishing governance for emerging technology, including AI usage policy, data protection, and vendor risk review
Track record of setting strategy and roadmaps, then delegating effectively while staying close enough to the details to coach and unblockExperience with configuration management and automation tools such as JAMF, Intune, Puppet, and Munki
Working knowledge of scripting and API integration (REST, OAuth, Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent)
Hands-on experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Claude, and OpenAI, including deployment, administration, and integration through APIs, connectors, and MCP servers
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making
How you work
A strong mix of problem solving and a positive, service-oriented attitude
Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners
Curiosity and a bias toward experimenting with AI in your own work, and the ability to lead a team through rapid change
At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead AI Studio, Asana's AI workflow builder, in Vancouver. The Product Management team drives Asana’s product strategy and execution, translating customer needs and opportunities into a compelling roadmap and working cross-functionally to deliver impactful solutions for team productivity and collaboration. In this role, you will own an end-to-end AI product that powers millions of workflows, enabling large enterprise organizations to build, govern, and deploy AI at scale across their organizations. You will join a dynamic cross-functional environment working directly with Engineering, Design, Experience Research, Data Science, and Go-To-Market teams to turn system-critical processes into reliable, automated work inside Asana's work graph.
This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. Own the product vision and prioritized roadmap for AI Studio end to end, tying every investment directly to customer impact, business outcomes, and Asana's mission.
Drive direct business outcomes for a consumption-based AI product: own reporting, forecasting, and ROI, and define the metrics that connect product usage to revenue on a consumption billing model.
Scale AI Studio to reliably support millions of workflows, ensuring the quality, performance, and dependability enterprises require for system-critical processes.
Ship automation capabilities that enable enterprise teams to deploy AI across their organizations, ranging from single-team workflows to processes spanning thousands of users.
Build for enterprise trust by shaping AI governance, admin controls, and change management capabilities so customers can roll out AI confidently and safely at scale.
Collaborate directly with large enterprise customers to understand how they manage complex workflows, translating those insights directly into the product roadmap.
Partner closely with engineering, design, data science, and GTM teams to turn ambiguous problems into shipped, high-impact product solutions.
About you
6+ years of product management experience, with a focus on AI, automation, workflow, or enterprise platform products.
Fluent in automation concepts, including workflow builders, rules engines, orchestration, triggers and actions, and integrations, with an understanding of how customers compose them into scaled, dependable processes.
Enterprise experience partnering with large customers managing workflows for thousands of users, including navigating AI governance, change management, and system-critical processes.
Proven track record of owning business outcomes for a product, including revenue or consumption metrics, reporting, and ROI analysis to drive prioritization and communicate impact to leadership.
Hands-on experience with modern AI tools, including building with LLMs, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, tool use, and evaluations, with the ability to reason about model behavior and trade-offs.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional partners, enterprise customers, and leadership.
Experience with consumption/usage-based billing products, AI evaluation systems, or enterprise AI deployments is a plus.

You'll define how Security as a function operates: how it plans, how it measures itself, how it communicates progress, and how it executes on its biggest bets. You won't just run programs, you'll shape the operating model that makes all programs run better.

Build dashboards and reporting cadences that give leadership real-time visibility into what's working, what's at risk, and where decisions are needed
Establish and continuously improve the operating cadences (All Hands meetings, program reviews, OKR check-ins) that keep the organization aligned and moving fast

asana-8237744.text:
AI Teammates are Asana’s flagship AI innovation - autonomous agents embedded directly into enterprise workflows that reason, act, and proactively drive work forward. The AI Agents/Teammates Platform (AITP) team owns the execution engine and platform layer that makes Asana's AI Teammates and other AI Agents effective, reliable, and scalable. We build the core systems behind agentic execution: model evaluation and rollouts, proactive detection of blocked work, execution quality infrastructure, tool orchestration, and the platform APIs, events, harness and agentic memory that power AI across all of Asana engineering. Rather than building a monolithic feature, we build a composable foundation. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to drive key architectural initiatives, design performant agentic runtime systems, and help build a reliable foundation that scales to millions of users.
Location: San Francisco, office-centric hybrid (in office Monday, Tuesday, Thursday). Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
What You’ll Achieve
Drive the technical design, architecture, and end-to-end delivery of medium-to-large projects across the AI Teammates execution engine, tool orchestration, and platform APIs & events.
Architect and own composable platform foundations, harness, memory, partnering with product engineering teams to enable them to build agentic capabilities into their domains in a self-serve manner.
Design robust, extensible, and performant systems that support agentic execution, prompt-driven automation, tool integrations, and strict enterprise-grade reliability boundaries.
Solve complex technical problems across model evaluations, latency tuning, and cost optimization while balancing technical debt, execution risk, and direct business goals.
Move quickly by shipping in small increments, validating with real customer usage, evals, and metrics, and adjusting based on what the data shows rather than assumptions.
Anticipate customer and architectural risks early, breaking down complex agentic product visions into clear engineering milestones and actionable tasks.
Take end-to-end ownership of and accountability for outcomes, not just delivery, from design through production, quality, and customer impact.
Proactively identify gaps and opportunities, then propose and drive new features, platform capabilities, and re-architecture, backed by customer feedback and usage data.
Champion technical excellence, write high-leverage design docs, establish evaluation methodologies, and mentor engineers across levels to raise the engineering bar.
Partner closely with Product Management, Design, Data Science, and external model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) to define requirements and align technical direction.
About You
6+ years building and running production distributed systems, microservices, or complex backend architectures.
A track record as Tech Lead or AoR owner, driving multi-contributor projects from ambiguity to delivery across teams and services.
High ownership and accountability: outcomes are yours, you follow through, and you raise risks early and openly.
Product and customer-first: you start from the customer problem, use feedback and data to shape direction, and bring ideas rather than waiting for specs. You understand how architecture and model behavior affect user trust, latency, and reliability.
Bias for action grounded in reality: you move fast and decide from customer feedback, production data, and eval results, and you know when a decision needs more rigor and when it can be reversed cheaply.
Strong design-doc skills and sound trade-off judgment (latency, cost, determinism, maintainability).
Hands-on experience or deep interest in LLMs, agentic patterns, eval pipelines, RAG, or real-time streaming.
A quick learner who ramps fast on new domains, codebases, and the AI landscape.
A passion for guiding and mentoring engineers with actionable code and design feedback.

asana-8098020.text:
The AI organization at Asana builds the platform and products that bring AI into how the world's teams work. That includes AI Teammates that take on work alongside people, the orchestration layer that lets agents plan and act across the Work Graph, and the AI platform that every AI feature at Asana runs on. The platform covers model access, retrieval, context, evaluation, and production quality.
We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction across this organization. You will lead the hardest cross-team problems in AI at Asana, make architectural calls that hold up as models and the industry shift underneath us, and help senior leadership shape where AI takes the product next. The scope spans multiple engineering teams across San Francisco, New York, Vancouver, and Warsaw.
This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
What you’ll achieve
Define the technical vision and architecture for Asana's AI Org that includes AI platform, Agent systems and Studio in partnership with engineering and product leadership
Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Security, and Legal to take ambitious AI products from prototype to reliable, trusted enterprise features
Lead strategic initiatives that span multiple teams, such as agent runtime and orchestration, context and memory for agents grounded in the Work Graph, and reliable, cost-efficient LLM inference at enterprise scale
Set the bar for how Asana measures AI quality, including offline and online evaluation, production monitoring, and the feedback loops that turn real usage into better agents
Make and guide high-stakes technical decisions on model and vendor strategy, build versus buy, and shared platform abstractions, and make sure those decisions age well

The AI Teammates Platform (AITP) team owns the execution engine and platform layer that makes these AI Teammates effective, reliable, and scalable.

We’re looking for people who care deeply about customers and are passionate about building products that improve the way millions of teams work together.
